items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: The interviewee (Bernard Steinau) does not speak in the provided transcript; the name 'Conny' is mentioned only by the interviewer in the context of other musicians (Bigard, Hodges).

ctx.x: We all were listening. We listened to Duke Allen's name mostly. Oh, I see.
